messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 8):
"""
60 months of continuous coverage Note :The accrued credits gained under the ported and migrated policies shall be counted for the purpose of calculating the Moratorium period. 14) No Claim Bonus: The Insurer may reward the policyholders who do not make claim in the form of No Claim Bonus (NCB). Such NCB shall be paid as per the choice/ express consent of the policyholder in the following forms at the time of every renewal: a) Cumulative Bonus: Addition in the Sum Insured without an associated increase in premium. and/or b) Discount in renewal Premium 15) Approval for Cashless facility: a. Every insurer shall strive to achieve 100% cashless claim settlement in a time bound manner. The insurers shall endeavor to ensure that the instances of claims being settled through reimbursement are at bare minimum and only in exceptional circumstances. b.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}
